newsitem.title: USA: Data Security names Singer CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Data Security names Singer CEO, president.

text.p: Data Security Corp said that it will change its name to World Wireless Communications Inc and that it named David Singer president and chief executive to replace Gary Peterson, who will remain with the company as a consultant.
The company did not provide specific details of Singer's appointment, effective last week. When asked if the company ousted Peterson, Singer said, "I'd rather not comment."
Singer said he had been working with Data Security since September as a consultant. Prior to that, he said he had been president and chief excutive officer of Navtech Industries.
